clashingPeople: Neeg Zog Kub (Gua 6 乾, 7 兑): Hluav taws rhuav Kub; thiab Neeg Zog Ntoo (Gua 3, 4).
housePositioning: Tso lub tsev tom qab thaj av dav uas muaj kev nyab xeeb, deb kaum ntse > 15m, ntsia kev sab laug.
entrancePlacement: ✓ Rooj Vag Zoo: Raws txoj kev sab laug (Dragon) deb kaum ntse > 15m. ✗ Txwv Rooj Vag: Qhib ncaj qha rau kaum ntse.
orientationFacing: Ntsia (Xiang): Ntsia kev sab laug; Zaum (Zuo): Zaum phab tsev luag sab xis; Taub hau pw: Phab ntsa tuab.
comprehensiveRemedy: Kev kho 4 kauj ruam: 1. Phab ntsa 2.2m txiav kaum ntse; 2. Tso pob zeb Tai Shan ntawm kaum; 3. Cog ntoo thuv 5 tsob thaiv kev; 4. Pas dej semicircular tua hluav taws kaum ntse.
geometryPhysics: Thaj av peb fab muaj txoj kev sab laug xwb (Zaj Ntsuab), sab xis yog tsev luag. Kaum ntse pem hauv ntej yog zog hluav taws.
entranceAnalysis: 1. Sab Laug (Zaj): ✓ Zoo - Qhov rooj vag thiab kev tsheb nkag deb kaum ntse > 15m. 2. Kaum Ntse: ✗ Txwv tsis qhib rooj vag.
waterAnalysis: 1. Pem hauv ntej tsev: ✓ Zoo - Pas dej semicircular khaws zog. 2. Kaum ntse: ✗ Txwv tsis khawb pas dej.
baguaSectors: Poob kaum sab qaum teb, yuav tsum cog ntoo thiab tsim phab ntsa kho.
remedy: Txiav kaum ntse nrog phab ntsa 2.2m, tso pob zeb Tai Shan, cog ntoo thaiv cua.
taboos: Txwv tsis tso tsev ze kaum ntse, txwv tsis qhib qhov rooj kaum, txwv tsis ntsia taub hau kaum.

name: San Jiao Tu: Kev Sab Xis (Thaj Av Peb Fab Kev Sab Xis)
baseName: San Jiao Tu: Kev Sab Xis (Thaj Av Peb Fab Kev Sab Xis)
category: 16 Qauv Duab Thaj Av & Kev Tso Vaj Tsev
elementGua: Zog Hluav Taws & Tsov Dawb (Fire & Tiger Sha / 火煞) - Tsov Dawb txav zog, ceev faj sib cav thiab teeb meem
favorablePeople: Tsis haum rau tsev neeg nyob yog tsis kho, siv tau rau chaw cia khoom lossis chaw nres tsheb.
clashingPeople: Neeg Zog Ntoo (Gua 3 震, 4 巽): Tsov Dawb Kub rhuav Ntoo; thiab pojniam cev xeeb tub.
housePositioning: Tso lub tsev tom qab thaj av dav uas muaj kev nyab xeeb, deb kaum ntse > 18m, ntsia kev sab xis.
entrancePlacement: ✓ Rooj Vag Zoo: Raws txoj kev sab xis deb kaum ntse > 18m thiab cog ntoo txo zog tsheb. ✗ Txwv Rooj Vag: Qhib ncaj qha rau kaum ntse.
orientationFacing: Ntsia (Xiang): Ntsia kev sab xis; Zaum (Zuo): Zaum phab tsev luag sab laug; Taub hau pw: Phab ntsa tuab.
comprehensiveRemedy: Kev kho 4 kauj ruam: 1. Phab ntsa 2.2m txiav kaum ntse pem; 2. Tso pob zeb Tai Shan; 3. Cog hav ntoo tuab 2.5m raws txoj kev sab xis; 4. Pas dej semicircular tua hluav tsov.
geometryPhysics: Thaj av peb fab muaj txoj kev sab xis xwb (Tsov Dawb), sab laug yog tsev luag. Tsov Dawb txav ceev tsim zog tshuam.
entranceAnalysis: 1. Sab Xis (Tsov): ⚠️ Ceev faj - Qhov rooj vag deb kaum ntse > 18m tsis pub dav tshaj 4m. 2. Kaum Ntse: ✗ Txwv tsis qhib.
waterAnalysis: 1. Pem hauv ntej tsev: ✓ Zoo - Pas dej semicircular tua zog tsov. 2. Kaum ntse: ✗ Txwv tsis khawb pas dej.
baguaSectors: Poob kaum sab hnub poob qaum teb, tsim teeb meem rau txiv tsev, yuav tsum kho nrog phab ntsa thiab teeb ci.
remedy: Txiav kaum ntse, tso pob zeb Tai Shan, cog ntoo thaiv Tsov Dawb, tso tsev rau chaw nyab xeeb.
taboos: Txwv tsis tso tsev ze kaum ntse, txwv tsis qhib qhov rooj kaum, txwv tsis qhib qhov rooj dav sab tsov.

name: San Jiao Tu: Kaum Ntse Pem (Thaj Av Peb Fab Kaum Ntse Ntsib Kev)
category: 16 Qauv Duab Thaj Av & Kev Tso Vaj Tsev
elementGua: Zog Hluav Ntse Pem (Front Fire Sha / 尖嘴煞) - Kaum ntse tua rau kev tsheb
favorablePeople: Tsis haum rau nyob yog tsis kho; haum rau tuam tsev, chaw tso roj tsheb, chaw muag hlau.
clashingPeople: Neeg Zog Kub (Gua 6, 7): Hluav taws hlawv kub ua mob ntsws/pob txha; thiab Neeg Dej (Gua 1).
housePositioning: Tso tsev rau sab nraub qaum dav 1/3 (Safe Rear Zone), thim deb ntawm kaum ntse pem > 15-20m, ua tsev rectangle 90°.
entrancePlacement: ✓ Qhov rooj zoo: Thim deb ntawm kaum ntse > 8m sab Zaj Ntsuab nrog kev S-Curve. ✗ Txwv tsis qhib: Qhov ntse kiag pem kev.
orientationFacing: Pem Tsev (向): Tsa rau sab thaj tshav kaj tom qab phab ntsa; Nraub Qaum (坐): Sab nraub qaum dav; Taub Hau: Phab ntsa ruaj.
comprehensiveRemedy: Kev kho 4 kauj ruam: 1. Phab ntsa 2.2m txiav kaum ntse pem; 2. Cog hav ntoo ntsuab/xyoob thaiv cua; 3. Tso pob zeb Tai Shan ntawm kaum ntse; 4. Ntsaws pas dej kaum ntse; tso dej semicircular pem tsev.
physics: Thaj av peb fab muaj kaum ntse taw ncaj rau txoj kev pem hauv ntej, nraub qaum dav. Kaum ntse < 36° ua rau muaj zog Hluav Taws Sha.
entrance: 1. Sab Zaj Ntsuab: ✓ Zoo - Rooj vag thim deb ntawm kaum ntse > 8m nrog kev nkhaus S-Curve. 2. Kaum ntse: ✗ Txwv kiag.
water: • Tsis muaj dej: Ua tshav xyoob ntsuab kaj. Yog xav ntxiv: Ntxiv tau semicircular pem tsev xwb (txwv khawb pas dej kaum ntse). • Yog muaj dej: Yog pas dej nyob kaum ntse lossis tom qab yuav tsum muab av ntsaws pov tseg! Yog pas dej semicircular pem tsev kom ceev cia.
bagua: Nraub qaum dav pab Xuan Wu tab sis pem ntse poob Ming Tang. Yuav tsum txiav kaum txhawm rau kho 8 fab Bagua.
remedy: Txiav kaum ntse 2.2m, tso pob zeb Tai Shan, cog ntoo thaiv cua, ntsaws pas dej kaum ntse, tso tsev rau nraub qaum dav 90°.
